reason: The policy farms the objective_bonus (+100) repeatedly by hovering in a loose success region (both legs contact, near pad, low vy) without terminating. The fix is to make the objective_bonus one-shot event-gated: it fires only once when the lander first achieves the success condition, tracked via a self._success_given flag. This aligns the reward with the evaluator's success definition (which requires episode termination). Additionally, the action_0_bonus is removed to prevent farming a per-step bonus for doing nothing near the pad. The distance_improvement_bonus cap is removed to provide a stronger gradient toward the pad without increasing the distance penalty (which failed previously). The controlled_descent_bonus and touchdown_stability_bonus remain one-shot as they are. This follows the phase_guidance_after_action_coverage mode by adding phase-specific guidance for the approach and touchdown phases without repeating failed patterns.
preserved_design: velocity_penalty (vertical and lateral) with same scales
fuel_penalty (small -0.01 per main engine use) kept as mild deterrent
angle_penalty (-0.02 * angle^2) kept as mild deterrent
changed_design: Make objective_bonus one-shot event-gated: +100 fires only once when the lander first achieves success (both legs contact, |x|<0.15, |y|<0.15, |vy|<0.5). Track with self._success_given flag. This prevents farming the bonus by hovering in the success region.
Remove action_0_bonus (was +0.1 per step when near pad and upright) to prevent farming a per-step bonus for doing nothing near the pad.

Remove the cap on distance_improvement_bonus: now +0.2 * (prev_distance - current_distance) without the min(..., 0.2) cap. This provides a stronger gradient toward the pad without increasing the distance penalty (which failed previously).
rejected_patterns_avoided: Do not increase distance penalty (failed pattern from iter_004): we keep the distance penalty at -0.02 * distance (implicit in the code? Actually the current code has no explicit distance penalty; the distance_improvement_bonus is the only distance-related term. We keep it as is but remove the cap.)
Do not make controlled_descent_bonus or touchdown_stability_bonus repeatable (failed pattern from iter_010->011): they remain one-shot.
Do not add new repeatable positive bonuses: we remove action_0_bonus instead.
Do not simply increase raw main-engine/action bonuses: we remove a per-step bonus and make the objective bonus one-shot.
action_coverage_plan: All actions already used. Removing action_0_bonus will reduce the incentive to use action 0 (do nothing) near the pad, potentially shifting some probability to orientation engines (actions 1 and 3) for fine-tuning position. The one-shot objective_bonus will encourage the policy to actually land (terminate) rather than hover.
phase_guidance_plan: Phase 1 (approach): distance_improvement_bonus (uncapped) provides a gradient to move toward the pad. Phase 2 (descent): controlled_descent_bonus (one-shot +10) fires when first using main engine near pad and upright. Phase 3 (touchdown): touchdown_stability_bonus (one-shot +20) fires when both legs contact near pad with low velocities. Objective_bonus (one-shot +100) fires upon successful landing. Crash_penalty (-100) deters failure.
payment_mode_plan: objective_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). controlled_descent_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). touchdown_stability_bonus is one-shot event-gated (fires once). distance_improvement_bonus is per-step but based on improvement (delta), so it naturally diminishes as the lander approaches the pad and cannot be farmed indefinitely. All other terms are per-step penalties.
